scene: The brass dial clicks, opening three transit bays along the dome edge.
picture: Pixel-art side view along the planetarium's polished floor. A South Asian girl with a long black braid in a teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair at centre. On the left waits a docked brass airship. To her right sits an idling yellow delivery truck, and at the far right stands a glowing glass elevator.
shown: A docked brass airship with an open gangway on the left
A yellow flatbed delivery truck parked idling on the right
A transparent glass elevator with sliding doors open on the far right
